articles.title: Baron Capital backs Vail Resorts board in proxy showdown with Oasis
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Vail Resorts Inc (NYSE:MTN) secured crucial backing on Friday from its largest and longest-standing shareholder, Baron Capital, bolstering management’s defense against an escalating proxy contest launched by activist investor Oasis Management. Ron Baron, whose firm controls approximately 18% of the mountain resort operator, announced he will vote for the company’s slate and support Chief Executive Rob Katz, while firmly opposing Oasis’s four dissident board nominees.
